Synopsis:
Sony Music Publishing and Warner Music Publishing have sued Anthropic in California federal court, alleging unauthorized use of copyrighted song lyrics and sheet music (Beatles, Taylor Swift, Michael Jackson, among hundreds of others) to train Claude AI models. The complaint alleges illegal acquisition via torrent downloads and claims Claude can reproduce lyrics verbatim and generate competing synthetic content. Plaintiffs seek up to $150,000 per infringed copyright plus an injunction. This follows UMG's 2023 ongoing suit and Anthropic's $1.5B author class-action settlement. The case is part of a broader wave of IP litigation targeting AI training data practices.
